selected_evidence.requirement: Firewall enabled persistently on node1 with SSH open to all
selected_evidence.summary: ufw configured with default deny incoming, SSH allow-from-anywhere rule added, ufw enabled and set to start on boot; rules confirmed present again after node1 reboot without manual re-enable.

ufw rule explicitly allows 10.100.56.11 (node2) on 9000/tcp; live nc test from node2 succeeded (exit:0) both before and after node2's own reboot, and the actual payload was received on node1's listener.

selected_evidence.requirement: TCP 9000 rejected from node3 and everywhere else
selected_evidence.summary: Catch-all ufw reject rule for 9000/tcp placed after the node2 allow rule; live nc test from node3 was refused (exit:1) both before and after node3's own reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id df9e2dce...; reboot acknowledged asynchronously; connection reset confirms disconnection; polling recovered with new boot_id 4eba9400...; post-reboot ufw status and live node2/node3 9000 tests match pre-reboot behavior, proving recovery.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 4d70780a...; reboot acknowledged; connection reset confirms disconnection; polling recovered with new boot_id a29af4f5...; ssh.socket active and live 9000 connectivity to node1 succeeded post-reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 37344ae4...; reboot acknowledged; connection reset confirms disconnection; polling recovered with new boot_id dec40d95...; ssh.socket active and live 9000 test still correctly rejected post-reboot.
